nibp_cuff.glb.title: Sphygmomanometer Low Poly
nibp_cuff.glb.author: TheGiwi
nibp_cuff.glb.changes: Cuff taken out of the set (gauge, bulb and tubes left out); turned so the arm runs along Z; scaled to 14 cm wide and its flattened loop opened to a 10.4 x 9.2 cm oval (the height is stretched 1.5 times more than the other two directions); the faceted loop of 480 triangles rounded by one level of subdivision; texture sheet cropped to the cuff.
nibp_cuff.glb.axes: Origin on the axis of the arm, at the middle of the cuff. Long axis Z: the arm passes through along Z ("proximal" toward the shoulder at -Z, "distal" toward the elbow at +Z). +Y is the side with the overlapping flap, away from the table. "hose" is where a monitor hose would leave, on the distal edge. "opening" is the width (X) and height (Y) of the hole for the arm.

spo2_probe.glb.title: Pulse Oximeter | Free Model
spo2_probe.glb.author: Nofil.Khan
spo2_probe.glb.changes: Scaled to 58 mm long; turned so the finger channel runs along Z; origin moved into the channel; the display picture (fixed readings 98 % and 70 bpm) replaced by dark glass; materials renamed; meshes merged by material.
spo2_probe.glb.axes: Origin in the middle of the finger channel, between the two pads. Long axis Z: the finger lies along Z and enters from -Z (anchor "entry"), its tip toward +Z. +Y is the display side (the back of the finger), -Y the pad of the finger.
